variationScope: No parameter override. All three arms used the current shared production curve and the same AI; only public difficulty and actual resource availability differ.

recommendation.reason: All three prespecified critical development arms passed the actual-resource and 90–98% point-estimate checks. Freeze this shared curve for an independent full release evaluation; this development result is not final acceptance.

limitations: This artifact contains only the three prespecified 500-game development arms; no old calibration or formal release outcomes are pooled.
No D10 baseline, D8 single-action arms, D6 no-removals-and-credits arm or defense-planning observation arm was resampled here. These remain part of a separate full release evaluation.
Wilson intervals describe uncertainty. A point estimate outside 90–98% remains a failure even if its confidence interval overlaps the band.
Natural healing, shielding, blocking and ordinary damage remain unchanged. Defense use is measured from consumed/generated totals; a planning switch does not establish absence of actual defense.
Defense strata are observational, not causal removal of defense. Provisional low/effective cutoffs are 20%/50%, distinct from the user-provided consumed/generated definition.
Candidate selection and these development seeds cannot be reused as unseen release validation.
